title: The planet, shaking
summary: A year of earthquakes: play it, scrub it, raise the floor.

window.sql: SELECT id, day, lat, lon, mag, depth_km, region, $day - day AS age FROM quakes WHERE mag >= $minmag AND day <= $day AND day > $day - 30 ORDER BY mag

daily.sql: SELECT day, max(mag) AS energy, count(*) AS n FROM quakes WHERE mag >= $minmag GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

stats.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, max(mag) AS biggest, arg_max(region, mag) AS region, arg_max(depth_km, mag) AS deep FROM quakes WHERE mag >= $minmag AND day <= $day AND day > $day - 30

history.sql: SELECT lat, lon FROM quakes WHERE mag >= $minmag AND day <= $day
